key_idea: The smallest observation is 3a and the largest is 3c, leaving only the middle distance to brute force.
sketch: Set a=d_min/3 and c=d_max/3, then try every b strictly between them, build the set of the 10 multiset sums and compare with the input list. At most ~330 candidates of constant work each. (b is also directly d_2-2a, but the set comparison is safer.) Pitfall: sums may coincide, which is why n can be as low as 7.
